title: Neuroprotection of Truncated Peptide IIAVE from Isochrysis zhanjiangensis: Quantum Chemical, Molecular Docking, and Bioactivity Studies.
authors: Liu, Qiuqi; Lin, Liyuan; Li, Huijuan; Qian, Zhong-Ji
one_liner_zh: 该文研究微藻来源多肽IIAVE的抗氧化神经保护作用，涉及量子化学计算和分子对接，但对象为多肽与Bcl-2/DJ-1蛋白，非蛋白质-DNA互作体系，且无AI或MD方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: Parkinson's disease (PD) is a progressive neurodegenerative disorder of the elderly for which there is no cure or disease-modifying therapy. Mitochondrial dysfunction and oxidative stress play a central role in dopaminergic neurodegeneration in PD. Therefore, antioxidants are considered a promising neuroprotective approach. In in vivo activity studies, 6-OHDA-induced oxidative stress in SH-SY5Y cells was established as a model of PD for cellular experiments. IIAVE (Ile-Ile-Ala-Val-Glu) was derived from Isochrysis zhanjiangensis octapeptide (IIAVEAGC), which has a small molecular weight. The structure and antioxidant activity of IIAVE were tested in a previous study and proved to have good antioxidant potential. In this study, the chemical properties of IIAVE were calculated using quantum chemical methods, including frontier molecular orbital (FMO), molecular electrostatic potential (MEP), natural population analysis (NPA), and global reactivity properties. The interaction of IIAVE with Bcl-2 and DJ-1 was investigated using the molecular docking method. The results showed that IIAVE promoted the activation of the Keap1/Nrf2 pathway and up-regulated the expression of the superoxide dismutase 1 (SOD-1) protein by inhibiting the level of reactive oxygen species (ROS) in cells. In addition, IIAVE inhibits ROS production and prevents 6-OHDA-induced oxidative damage by restoring mitochondrial membrane potential. Furthermore, IIAVE inhibited cell apoptosis by increasing the Bcl-2/Bax ratio and inhibiting the activation of Caspase-9 and Caspase-3. Thus, IIAVE may become a potential drug for the treatment and prevention of PD.
abstract_zh: 帕金森病（Parkinson's disease, PD）是一种老年人进行性神经退行性疾病，目前尚无治愈方法或疾病修饰疗法。线粒体功能障碍和氧化应激在PD的多巴胺能神经退行性变中发挥核心作用。因此，抗氧化剂被认为是一种有前景的神经保护策略。在体内活性研究中，以6-OHDA诱导的SH-SY5Y细胞氧化应激作为PD细胞实验模型。IIAVE（Ile-Ile-Ala-Val-Glu）源自湛江等鞭金藻八肽（IIAVEAGC），其分子量较小。前期研究已测试了IIAVE的结构和抗氧化活性，并证明其具有良好的抗氧化潜力。本研究采用量子化学方法计算了IIAVE的化学性质，包括前沿分子轨道（FMO）、分子静电势（MEP）、自然布居分析（NPA）和全局反应性属性。利用分子对接方法研究了IIAVE与Bcl-2和DJ-1的相互作用。结果表明，IIAVE通过抑制细胞内活性氧（ROS）水平，促进Keap1/Nrf2通路的激活，并上调超氧化物歧化酶1（SOD-1）蛋白的表达。此外，IIAVE通过恢复线粒体膜电位，抑制ROS产生，并防止6-OHDA诱导的氧化损伤。进一步地，IIAVE通过增加Bcl-2/Bax比值并抑制Caspase-9和Caspase-3的激活，抑制细胞凋亡。因此，IIAVE可能成为治疗和预防PD的潜在药物。
